name: interview-prep-app
description: Interview prep tracker: Angular + Express + PostgreSQL + AI

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm start -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web -- --watch=false
